- Summary: Completed phone consultation/intake with [Client], who was released from prison on 10/20/2026 and is currently residing at a halfway house. - Stability Tier: Stable
- Stated Goals Progress: [Client] identified three goals: (1) reinstate driver's license, (2) employment, (3) housing in his own apartment. Goals set this session; no progress yet. A case plan will be built around these goals.

Currently at a halfway house with a projected release of 12/29/2026, possibly earlier as good-time days are applied (per conversation with halfway house staff today). Three years of supervision will follow release.
- Gate 2 (Housing, Comms, Legal, Resume): Housing: currently at halfway house. Not interested in transitional or shared housing and wants his own apartment. Has family he can stay with as a fallback.
